title: Treizeci
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Heroes of the Realm characters)

paragraphs.text: Treizeci is a human knight from an unknown plane who cares for Nostalgia .

The character of Treizeci was created by Wizards of the Coast for a celebration card as part of the 2023 Heroes of the Realm program. It was given to members of the 30th Anniversary celebration team. His appeareance resembles that of a classic knight riding an armored horse. He has a red cape. He gains power and toughness through Nostalgia and is able to call forth Serra Angels .
